title: Deploy union-eyes to production (August 2026 cadence — CourtLens doctrine convergence)
description: Successor to CHG-2026-0107 (window closed 2026-08-03). Covers the union-eyes PROD deployment triggered by merge of PR #693 (CourtLens doctrine convergence) into main on 2026-08-27. PR #693 is documentation- and SoT-scoped (governance/portfolio/product-catalog.json, platform/products/*.json, tooling/repo-inventory/output/*, docs/, apps/abr surface). It does NOT modify any code under apps/union-eyes/ or shared runtime packages consumed by union-eyes at runtime; the deploy runs because the shared portfolio-catalog and inventory artifacts are regenerated on main and the pipeline treats any main push as a deployable event. All governance gates on PR #693 passed (74 checks green, 0 fail) including doctrine validator (7 checks), tier-focus, portfolio drift, and inventory lock.
impact_summary: Documentation and SoT-only deploy for union-eyes. No union-eyes app-code changes, no schema migrations, no runtime dependency changes. Rollback via previous image digest if needed.
rollback_plan: Revert to previous stable union-eyes container image digest (the digest deployed under CHG-2026-0107 window). Since PR #693 introduced no union-eyes runtime code changes, rollback risk is minimal.
